embeds.title: Nothing is undercutting CrofAI
embeds.description: Set aside: StreamLake on DeepSeek V4 Flash 0731, is cheaper only at its own 86% cache hit rate; at the 80% this model runs, CrofAI is 1% cheaper. merge-gateway on GLM 5.3 Flash, resold route flattened to one price, 76% under CrofAI. bothub on Gemma 4 31B, listed at $0, not purchasable per token. unorouter on Gemma 4 31B and GLM 5.2, listed at $0, not purchasable per token. requesty on Gemma 4 31B, listed at $0, not purchasable per token. ovhcloud on Qwen3.8 27B, listed at $0, not purchasable per token.
